Ryan Graves, a former Navy fighter pilot, talks with Joe Rogan in episode 1883 of the Joe Rogan Experience. Graves flew F/A-18 jets and later reported strange objects near his carrier group. He went public with what pilots were seeing, and helped push the UFO topic into Congress.

Graves describes the objects pilots called tic-tacs and the radar and camera records behind them. He explains why pilots stayed silent for years and what changed after official reports came out. Rogan asks what the objects might be and who might control them. It is a calm, firsthand account from a witness in uniform.
